The process involved in the recycling process of used oil and other petroleum based-by-product entails a lot of dirt and sludge. Preliminary treatment is effective means of purging the material from other impurities, such as common dirt and muddy sludge. These impurities are part of the whole used material extracted. The time element is basically necessary for the oil pollutant to afloat on the surface and for the solid pollutant to settle on the bottom. The used oil collected is then heated …

The residual sludge will then be dewatered by filtration. It will then be air dried or evaporated to remove the moisture of the sludge. After the sludge is dewatered and dried out, the material must be sampled and sent out for analysis. The results of the analyses will determine the use of the dried sludge.

When condensed, the condensate will be collected. The higher boiling point portion of the mixture that does not vaporize remains at the bottom. This portion is valuable as a fuel source for certain industries to recover the heat value.

All syngases are oxidized in SOC in controlled environment specially to avoid formation of high-temperature thermal NOx, but at the same time keep the temperature high enough …
